name: Sikament ECO-3 W
paste:
SIKAMENT® ECO-3 W: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikament® ECO-3 W, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/sikament_eco-3_w.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikament® ECO-3 W where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sikament® ECO-3 W is a water reducer and non-chloride accelerator admixture based on modified copolymer technology, which provides a cost effective solution in accelerated soft concrete.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikament® ECO-3 W is used to accelerate the finishing and setting time of concrete when ambient temperatures are low. (Set times are better than the times associated with the action of normal water reducing admixtures). Early age development of concrete and mortar mixes is improved.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikament® ECO-3 W
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: WRAc - Water Reducing and Set-Accelerator
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Sikament® ECO-3 W complies and exceeds the limits of AS 1478.1-2000 as type WRAc.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS 1478.1-2000: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Improved workability and finishability.
    - Higher slump can be achieved without further addition of water.
    - Improved setting times of concrete in winter conditions.
    - Improved plastic concrete properties
    - Enables concrete to achieve internal cohesiveness with improved placement properties.
    - Lower bleed rates.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Mixture modified co-polymer and complexing agents
    - Appearance and colour: Clear red liquid
    - Density: 1.42 g/cm³ approximately
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries, 1000 litre IBC, 205 litre drum, 10 litre container.
    - Shelf life: Stored at temperature between 5°C and 35°C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight and frost, shelf life is one (1) year.
    - Storage conditions: Store at temperature between 5°C and 35°C protected from direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Compatibility: Sikament® ECO-3 W can be used in conjunction with many Sika Concrete admixtures, except Sikament NN. When using Sikament® ECO-3 W, site trials are always recommended to achieve the best results.
4.3 Recommended dosage. Typical dosage is 600ml per 100kg of total cementitious material. Sikament® ECO-3 W can be dosed between 350 ml to 1200 ml per 100 kg of total cementitious material to improve water reduction and setting time. Optimum dosage should be determined by site trials with the particular concrete mix design.
4.4 Dispensing. Sikament® ECO-3 W should be added to the gauging water or poured simultaneously into the concrete mixer. For optimum utilisation of the high water reduction, we recommend thorough mixing at a minimal wet mixing time of 1 minute/cubic metre. The addition of the remaining gauging water to fine tune concrete consistency may be started after 2/3 of the wet mixing time, to avoid surplus water in concrete.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations. Do not use with naphthalene based admixtures.
4.6 Further information. May slightly increase air content of concrete

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikament® ECO-3 W, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/sikament_eco-3_w.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikaiment® ECO-3 W, version 27/05/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/sds-sikaiment-eco-3w.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD Sikament® ECO-3 W, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/epd-sikament-eco-3w.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
